items.title: Curtis Fuller — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Win, and Cedar I couldn’t stand to watch.

ctx.x: He’s editing as he’s trying to play. I mean, do you know what that is to watch? Win, and Cedar I couldn’t stand to watch. Cedar had a way like Elvin. Cedar’s time movement with his foot, I couldn’t look at it
Because he would throw you off?
